cases.purpose: Exercise compressed live module loading with parameters and ordered dependency-chain removal.
cases.oracle: kmod dry-run plan and kernel module inventory and sysfs, in an isolated disposable guest.
cases.comparison: All plan modules must be initially absent; Linux lists newly inserted modules in reverse load order. Check compressed nbd parameters, chain order and removal. Missing prerequisites exit 125.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ && $(type -t bashkmod) == builtin ]] || exit 125
has() { local n; while read -r n _; do [[ $n == "$1" ]] && return 0; done </proc/modules; return 1; }
plan=$(/usr/sbin/modprobe -n -v br_netfilter) || exit 125
order=(); paths=()
while read -r verb path rest; do
  [[ $verb == insmod ]] || continue
  n=${path##*/}; n=${n%%.ko*}; n=${n//-/_}
  has "$n" && exit 125
  order+=("$n"); paths+=("$path")
done <<< "$plan"
(( ${#order[@]} >= 2 )) || exit 125
has nbd && exit 125
nbdplan=$(/usr/sbin/modprobe -n -v nbd) || exit 125
[[ $nbdplan == 'insmod '*.ko.xz* ]] || exit 125
[[ -r /sys/module/compression && $(</sys/module/compression) == xz ]] || exit 125
cleanup() { /usr/sbin/modprobe -r br_netfilter >/dev/null 2>&1; /usr/sbin/modprobe -r nbd >/dev/null 2>&1; }
trap cleanup EXIT
bashkmod modprobe nbd nbds_max=4 || exit 1
has nbd || exit 1
[[ $(</sys/module/nbd/parameters/nbds_max) == 4 ]] || exit 1
bashkmod modprobe -r nbd || exit 1
has nbd && exit 1
bashkmod modprobe br_netfilter || exit 1
# Linux /proc/modules lists newly inserted modules in reverse insertion order.
new=(); while read -r n _; do for want in "${order[@]}"; do [[ $n == "$want" ]] && new+=("$n"); done; done </proc/modules
(( ${#new[@]} == ${#order[@]} )) || exit 1
for ((i=0; i<${#order[@]}; i++)); do [[ ${new[i]} == "${order[${#order[@]}-1-i]}" ]] || exit 1; done
bashkmod modprobe -r br_netfilter || exit 1
for n in "${order[@]}"; do has "$n" && exit 1; done
printf 'compressed-nbd=params-and-remove-ok chain=load-order-and-remove-ok\n'
